direct-restore-health.scope: Stock Restore Health 1.0 and 3.0 healed the selected wounded friendly player by 15 and 84. The client suppressed early sibling clicks during family 685 reuse.

direct-repair-rsi.scope: Stock Repair RSI 2.0, 3.0 and 4.0 healed the selected wounded friendly player by 24, 57 and 91. The client suppressed early sibling clicks during family 686 reuse.

quick-coding-direct-heal.head: b9bc7952e522229b602d80a6bd7125f442493719
quick-coding-direct-heal.scope: Stock Quick Coding healed the selected wounded friendly player from 371 to 386 with the staged +20% Healing influence.

healing.source: Shipped GOB 80 specifies fixed type-3 heal 13, two-second cast, and four-second own reuse and family 685.
healing.runtime: AbilitySupport admits the selected friendly target, AbilityHealing applies the caster's healing influence, and HealSelf publishes HP on the recipient view. AbilityCooldowns sends both reuse timers and gates sibling casts.
healing.test: AbilityEvidenceDirectHealsMode verifies actual HP 100 to 115, the recipient view and exact own timer starts and shared timer starts and ends. The two sibling-refusal samples verify the shared runtime gate. Stock activated each heal with one request and the early siblings produced no request. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/344#issuecomment-7008739616
